description: This header file defines the template class 'ScreenConnector' which manages screen frame processing, callback setting, and frame injection for a screen sharing or rendering system within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes mechanisms for handling frame queues, callback registration, and interaction with other components like WaylandScreenConnector and HostModeCtrl.

classes.name: ScreenConnector
classes.description: A template class managing screen frame processing, callback registration, and frame queue handling for a specific ProcessedFrameType within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to process frames, sets the frame callback for the WaylandScreenConnector, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: InjectFrame
methods.description: Injects a new frame into the processing pipeline, skipping if in confirmation UI mode, and pushes the processed frame into the queue.

methods.name: IsCallbackSet
methods.description: Checks if the frame processing callback has been set.

methods.name: SetDisplayEventCallback
methods.description: Sets a display event callback on the WaylandScreenConnector.

methods.name: OnNextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the next processed frame from the queue.

methods.name: RenderConfirmationUi
methods.description: Handles frames to be rendered for confirmation UI, processes the frame via callback, and pushes it into the UI queue.
